cache_counts.legacy_explanation: The 20 legacy rows use source-cross-references-1.0 keys. v2 keys include registry-qualified-association-2.0, so both policy histories remain preserved. These are expected historical policy overlaps; replay creates no duplicate v2 matrices.

count_definitions.scope: Mechanism and inheritance totals include retained legacy entries when explicitly labeled all_current. Mapping uncertainty, resolution and source distributions refer to the 15,577 qualified-policy v2 matrices. Legacy entries are unchanged historical policy results.
count_definitions.direct_mechanisms: Number of matrices containing at least one applicable direct assertion of each mechanism; overlaps are allowed.
count_definitions.unknown_undetermined: no_candidate_mechanism includes matrices without applicable explicit mechanisms. with_unknown_applicable_g2p_assertion separately counts original G2P assertions normalized UNKNOWN in matching disease/inheritance scope.
count_definitions.context_only: No applicable direct assertion and at least one contextual evidence row. Mapping uncertainty counts overlap.

unknown_inheritance_query_scope.behavior: Existing all-scopes query behavior; source and hypothesis requirements remain explicit and separate. No inheritance equivalence is inferred.

integrity.fingerprint_scope: Pinned original source projection; the live source database gained two gnomAD rows from outside this task and was not modified or rolled back.

idempotence.expected_operational_changes: A new independent bulk journal was added. Expired source-state TTLs can refresh operational state and matrix updated_at timestamps. Immutable scientific tables, all matrix scientific fields and current snapshot pointers are exactly unchanged.

stratified_source_comparison.method: Deterministic snapshot-ID order; first two matrices per mechanism, inheritance, resolution, reconciliation, uncertainty and source composition stratum, plus ALL matrices for MYH7, MYBPC3, LMNA, FLNA and GLA. Entire cache raw/hash/scope verification supplements sampling.
stratified_source_comparison.source_comparison_scope: Unchanged original acquired local index rows; no newly downloaded data.
